example.question: According to the AMF's (Autorité des marchés financiers) 2025 annual report, what is the maximum fine its Enforcement Committee may impose in general, and to what share of the sanctioned entity's turnover may fines be increased in certain cases?
example.reference_answer: The Enforcement Committee may impose fines of up to €100 million or ten times the amount of the benefit derived from the regulatory breach, if this can be determined. In certain cases (the report does not specify which), these fines may be increased to 15% of the sanctioned entity's total annual turnover.
